title: Review and tune SVG output
description:
Polish the SVG output of 'pebbles flow --format svg'. The backend renders a column-based layout with status colors and 30-char title truncation (src/flow.rs render_svg), but the output has not been reviewed or tuned, and it is not currently used in production, so this work remains open.

Goals:
- Box sizing and spacing (currently cramped?)
- Arrow positioning (currently center; should be edge?)
- Font sizes and readability
- Title truncation handling
- Color palette consistency with pebbles style
- Layout dimensions (currently very wide?)

Interactive enhancements (tooltips, HTML export) are tracked separately in b7bfe193.
